text.text_excerpt: I have had lunch at Begue's before, but never been able to catch their Sunday Brunch. On our last stay at the Royal Sonesta, I finally got to catch the Sunday Brunch at Begue's and it did NOT disappoint! At 43.00 per person, it's not cheap, but it is the BEST brunch buffet I have ever seen or had.....anywhere... Cruise ship, 5 star hotel... anywhere... The staff is fabulous. Always polite and attentive. The restaurant itself is elegant, with a courtyard and is exactly what you would imagine when thinking of a fancy Sunday brunch in the French Quarter. There is even a piano player playing background music... In talking to the staff, it sounds as though they change the buffet up quite a bit...

I was lucky to be invited to a Sunday Champagne Brunch at this lovely restaurant within the Royal Sonesta Hotel. We had reservations too so parking was free! On the web site it says there is complimentary parking with confirmed reservations. The hotel/restaurant has parking in the back and don't let the sign fool you, it wasn't completely full. A small group of us had a nice round table and we all started off with mimosas. The service was excellent, we were well tended to, and I really enjoyed the piano in the background. The breakfast buffet was awesome! I tried to get a little bit of everything and generally most of the portions were cute and small so you could feasibly try everything o...

This Sunday marked our 6th time at Begue for champange brunch. As usual it was great. We had our favorite server, a lovely elder lady, who knew just how we like our champagne, cold and keep em coming. We made a reservation since it was a busy convention weekend in town and didn't want to miss out. We were seated promptly, even though we were a few minutes late (opps). The food as usual was good. There were a few outstanding bits. I highly recommend the chef created small plates. This week we had a spiced apple and goat cheese plate and a tomato napoleon that were fabulous.
